title: Print
description:
A complete print: one theme applied to an ordered list of sheets on
one size and orientation.

orientation.description: How every sheet is turned. Absent means portrait.

outline.description:
The sheet titles of the complete print, in order. A preview
print lists more titles than it has sheets: the app continues
it from this list later. Leave it empty when the print is
complete.

sheets.description:
Sheets in reading order. One sheet is a poster; two sheets are
the front and back of a flyer.

size.description: The paper size every sheet is laid out on. Absent means A4.

theme.description: Visual identity applied to every sheet.

title.description: Print title, shown in the editor. Not rendered on a sheet.

body.description: Family for every other text element that sets no font.

heading.description: Family for text elements with role `title` or `heading`.

Orientation.description:
How the sheet is turned. Landscape swaps the width and the height
of the size.

oneOf.description: The short edge is the width.
The long edge is the width.

accent.description: Color for highlights, shapes, and chart series that set no color.

background.description: Screen background color when a screen sets no background.

muted.description: Secondary color for captions, rules, and table stripes.

text.description: Text color when an element sets no color.

PrintSize.description: The paper size a print is laid out on.

Sheet.description:
One sheet: an HTML fragment for the print's size, CSS for that
fragment, and author notes.

css.description:
CSS for this sheet only. The server scopes every selector to
this sheet. Use plain selectors such as `.title` or `h1`. Use the
theme through `var(--background)`, `var(--text)`, `var(--accent)`,
`var(--muted)`, `var(--heading-font)`, `var(--body-font)`,
`var(--mono-font)`. No `@import`, no viewport units, no `<`.

html.description:
The sheet as one HTML fragment. The canvas is the print's `size` in px, rotated by its `orientation`: 559 by 794 for A5, 794 by 1123 for A4, 1123 by 1587 for A3, 816 by 1056 for Letter, 1056 by 1632 for Tabloid. Use px units. `, `
`, ``. Not allowed:
`

notes.description:
Author notes: print instructions such as paper stock or bleed,
intent, or handoff remarks. Never rendered on the sheet and
never exported.

Theme.description:
Default colors and fonts that elements inherit when they omit their
own.

name.description: Theme name shown in the editor.
